notes: U1 and U2 rates are set by each employee's health insurance fund; the defaults are KNAPPSCHAFT's 2026 rates (U1 0.8%, U2 0.22%). U1 applies only to employers with up to 30 employees.
The employee share shown assumes a childless employee aged 23 or over (it includes the 0.6% care surcharge, which the employer does not share).
Statutory accident insurance (Berufsgenossenschaft) is not included: its rates depend on the industry and are billed separately.
The calculator covers salaries above the Midijob range (more than €2,000 a month); for Minijobs use the Minijob calculator.
